claim: The single-wave leaf extension to (5120,10240) and (5120,12288) is bit-identical to shared-B on every measured row. Recorded 1.02x-1.28x speedups were measured in a fixed arm order, not a counterbalanced protocol, and (5120,12288) row 128 straddles parity; speed and that band edge are under task #25 correction. Measured losing shapes remain useful negative evidence.
hardware: epyc / AMD Radeon Pro W7900 gfx1100 / Ryzen 9 5950X
command_note: The prior field combined multiple invocations with prose ('then the same tool') and omitted required --output arguments from the pin-down runs, so it was not executable as-run provenance. Raw argv was not retained; these are labelled semantic templates.
protocol: Canonical repack_gguf_q4_k_tile16 payloads over a valid Q4_K block image, one weight upload per shape, wall around one launch plus device_synchronize, fixed arm order with two back-to-back passes per arm and best-of-two selection (not counterbalanced), ratios shared_b/single_wave, worst BF16 ULP distance against shared-B, outputs finite.

single_wave_ratio_vs_shared_b.note: per-run measurements, not one merged table. Rows appear under the run that measured them; the two runs are different rep counts on the same build and disagree by up to 5% at the band edge.

ulp_vs_shared_b: 0 at every row and every shape measured

promoted.row6_routes_untouched: both shapes are in GGUF_Q4_T16_PHYSICAL_C1_ROWTILE_SHAPES and the row-6 branch is checked first, so their measured 7.28x and 7.32x rows6 rowtile wins are preserved

band_confidence.(5120,17408): wins in every measurement through rows 128 (1.09-1.41x)
band_confidence.(5120,10240): wins in every measurement through rows 128 (1.08-1.26x), and still wins at 144/160
band_confidence.(5120,12288): wins in every measurement through rows 112 (1.10-1.28x); rows 128 is noise-bounded 0.97-1.02

first_token_ab.protocol: public hipengine.LLM API, production profile, one 35-token suite prompt, max_tokens=1, third-iteration steady state, same build, HIPENGINE_GGUF_Q4_T16_SINGLE_WAVE_MAX_ROWS=0 to disable all three shapes
first_token_ab.note: the two new shapes add ~2.2 ms on top of the -7.75% already banked for (5120,17408), which is small because the 35-token prompt admits few rows through those projections

down_projection_is_the_remaining_gap.reading: It is the most expensive measured dense launch and about 1.7x slower than gate/up on the same 51.5 MB payload. W7900 has 96 CUs, not 512: grid 107 with 128-thread blocks is 428 wave32s, about 4.46 waves/CU versus a maximum 32. That supports a latency-hiding/occupancy hypothesis, not a proven CU underfill or split-K win. No validly measured registered leaf beats it; task #22 must confirm current prefill attribution, then #11 must compare finer tiling against split-K operation-complete cost under a strict RED gate.
down_projection_is_the_remaining_gap.other_measured_losses: (5120,6144), (6144,5120) and (5120,1024) have no registered leaf that beats shared-B at these rows either; their owners cost 0.30-0.49 ms.

gates.red_first: tests/test_gguf_q4_k_t16_dense.py failed on the three-shape policy set before the shapes were added
gates.numerics: bit-exact at every measured row and shape, so no KL/top-1 gate was required for the changed leaves
gates.fallback: shared-B remains the registered strict sibling; HIPENGINE_GGUF_Q4_T16_SINGLE_WAVE_MAX_ROWS=0 disables the whole band on the same build

scratch_hygiene: Sweep JSON stays in /tmp/he-t16; only the ratios and this summary are committed.
review_correction: The original harness and artifact said both arm orders, but source executes one fixed order. Speed ratios are provisional; ULP-0 correctness is unaffected. W7900 geometry is 96 CUs. Unknown as-run argv is null rather than reconstructed as fact.

run_disagreement.material_one: (5120,12288) at rows 128 straddles parity: 0.970 in the 15-rep all-shapes sweep and 1.022 in the 20-rep pin-down. The promotion band for that shape is therefore strongly supported only through rows 112; at rows 128 the effect is inside measurement noise and could be a small regression.
run_disagreement.material_two: (5120,12288) at rows 67 measured 1.106 and 1.075, and (5120,10240) at rows 128 measured 1.083 and 1.110. Both runs win in every measurement, so only the quoted digit changes.
run_disagreement.correction_reason: the first version of this artifact merged points from the 15-rep all-shapes sweep and the 20-rep pin-down runs into a single per-shape table without labelling which run each point came from, and cited the pin-down value for (5120,12288) rows 67/128 in a table that read like the sweep. Every individual number was a real measurement, but the table was not one consistent protocol, and the unlabelled merge happened to flatter the (5120,12288) band edge.
run_disagreement.code_left_unchanged: At this correction commit the global row cap is still 128, but task #25 is required to narrow (5120,12288) to the evidence-backed row 112 unless a repaired counterbalanced repeat proves row 128 non-regressive. Uncertainty cannot remain in a production default.
